_comment: D-12. One row per PS26176 requirement line. Status is BUILT only where the running system actually does the thing; everything else is MOCKUP and says why. Do not mark a row BUILT to make the tally look better.

rows.requirement: Accept a natural-language question about sea safety and answer it on a map with cited evidence
rows.note: Text query -> planner -> agent graph -> answer card, map layer spec, and an evidence panel listing the sources actually used.

rows.requirement: Accept and answer in English, Malayalam and Tamil
rows.note: Language is detected and carried through the graph, and the UI selector is wired, but generated explanations are English-only templates. No translation model is integrated.

rows.requirement: Carry conversational context across at least three turns
rows.note: Session holds location, time_window and boat_id; a new utterance overwrites only the fields it states. Chips render the retained context and flash on change.

rows.requirement: Select data sources from a live registry rather than a hardcoded pipeline, prioritising ISRO/Indian sources
rows.note: Ranking function over the D-14 registry, tier-1 attempted first, fallback logged as its own trace step. New sources can be added via POST /api/registry with no code change.

rows.requirement: Produce a return-window crossing verdict and turn-back time for a named inlet, specific to a registered hull class
rows.note: Deterministic index over wave/tide/direction/swell/lightning/cyclone, banded per hull via D-10. Two hull classes on identical conditions yield different verdicts.

rows.requirement: Expose an inspectable multi-agent reasoning trace in which one agent's output changes another's decision
rows.note: Every node records input, output and duration; hinge events are detected and rendered with the cause stated. Trace is persisted and replayable by trace_id.

rows.requirement: Refuse to publish any advisory whose language output contradicts its computed number
rows.note: Deterministic comparator checks the verdict token and every numeral in the generated text against the computed payload. 20-case M-03 suite passes, contradictions at 100%.

rows.requirement: Poll hazard conditions on a fixed schedule, independent of any question, and raise alerts on threshold breach
rows.note: APScheduler job evaluates every registered boat against its hull threshold on an interval and writes alerts into the same PENDING_RELEASE pipeline a query uses.

rows.requirement: Report a validated skill score against a naive baseline over a historical record
rows.note: Contingency table, POD, FAR and days-per-year recomputed from the record on every request, compared to Hs > 2.0 m at equal POD. Ground truth is synthetic, so this validates the method, not a field skill claim.

rows.requirement: Serve five distinct stakeholder views from one shared agent stack
rows.note: Persona config (D-16) drives layers, framing and suggested queries. The graph is byte-identical across all five personas.

rows.requirement: Compile every advisory into SMS, VHF script, printed slip and landing-centre board formats
rows.note: All four render from the live advisory with real character counts and hull-class buckets. VHF audio is a pre-rendered tone placeholder, not speech.

rows.requirement: Check a declared fishing ground against restricted, protected and boundary zones before departure
rows.note: Point-in-polygon plus buffer against the zone layer, returning zone name, type and distance. Zone polygons are synthetic and flagged as such.

rows.requirement: Compute a least-cost advisory route corridor with bearing and waypoints
rows.note: Endpoint returns a straight-line corridor with bearing and waypoints. No H3 cost surface and no A* search - the hazard cost grid is not built.

rows.requirement: Run end-to-end offline on one laptop with no network calls
rows.note: Backend, database and all data are local; the demo needs no external service. Map base tiles still load from a CDN, so the map pane degrades to layers-only without network.
